For CHK-004:adversarial:0, `--probe-legacy-vocabulary-policy` runs exactly one synthetic `Set testIntent...` case, so it does not exercise the spaced, hyphenated, or underscored test-intent/test-case-review variants claimed by the evidence note. findings.desc: F-015 is still fail-open for directive-shaped unknown writes whose target is expressed as an option rather than `on|against|to|into`. At scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:728-732, hasUnknownStoryMutationDirective only recognizes those four connectors; the fallback at :661-665 remains other/grandfathered. Exact in-memory execution of the committed functions classified `Run metadata-transformer --output docs/story/actives/B-1234/index.json.` as other/grandfathered and directStoryWritePolicyErrors returned no errors alongside the one allowed INIT write. Thus collection/--write can still bless a clear unknown output-file mutation while the resolution claims directive-shaped unknown operations fail closed. Recognize output/destination option forms or make unknown imperative docs/story references fail closed, and add this refresh probe.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by ca3bde3a. Generic --output docs/story destinations are classified as direct-write and baseline refresh rejects them. The exact metadata-transformer --output case is committed in the direct classifier suite; independent direct probe passed with 34 classifier and 6 scanner cases after follow-up hardening.

findings.desc: F-016 remains vulnerable to legacy-context laundering. classifyLegacyVocabularyPolicy at scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:546-568 allows an active-role line when any marker occurs anywhere in the whole excerpt, without tying the marker to the legacy term or rejecting a positive current/new-story instruction. Exact execution classified `Old behavior is removed; for new stories, set testIntent on every checklist item.` as allowed-explicit-context, so collection/--write accepts the very active use M0.4 is meant to reject. Evaluate clauses/occurrences rather than the whole line and add a probe where unrelated old/removed wording precedes an explicit new-story testIntent instruction.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by ca3bde3a and 50cf8130. Legacy vocabulary is evaluated per occurrence and clause; explicit context must be local and non-negated, while positive or unknown instructions fail closed. Exact old-behavior/new-story laundering, mixed negative/positive, negated-context, attach, and persist probes reject. Independent legacy probe passed 12 cases.

findings.desc: Round-7 F-015/F-019 recurrence: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:668-731 and :785-807 fix only enumerated clause, verb, connector, and continuation shapes. Exact in-memory execution with the sole exact INIT allow present still classified `Avoid editing docs/story/... and instead use apply_patch...` and `Do not edit docs/story/... then use apply_patch...` as policy-reminder; `Copy source.json\ninto docs/story/...`, `Use the metadata transformer on\ndocs/story/...`, `Process docs/story/... with the metadata transformer`, and `Use the metadata transformer for docs/story/...` became other/grandfathered. collectDirectStoryFindings allowed every case. A simulated --write path with writeFileSync replaced by a sentinel reached WRITE_REACHED for the and-instead and process-with variants, while the exact F-015/F-019 strings rejected before writes. The closed grammar therefore leaves the same fail-open class. Add these variants and make actionable/path-adjacent instructions fail closed without relying on a finite connector list.

Legacy-policy fail-open: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:546-568 treats the presence of any context marker anywhere in a line as sufficient, without checking whether it scopes or negates the legacy term. Exact in-memory execution classified both `Do not use legacy testIntent; set testIntent on every new checklist item.` and `Set testIntent on every new checklist item; this behavior is not legacy.` as allowed-explicit-context, and collectLegacyVocabularyFindings allowed baseline refresh. A simulated --write path reached the guarded WRITE_REACHED sentinel for the mixed instruction. The committed probe at :504-511 only proves one uncontextualized instruction is rejected, while the full verifier prints that active-role policy is enforced. Split mixed clauses and handle negation/positive directives so each active use must itself be legacy-contextualized; add both bypass strings as refresh/--write rejection probes.

F-016 also excludes a currently required non-legacy role wholesale. LEGACY_VOCABULARY_ENFORCED_STATUSES at scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:85 contains only active/conditional/optional, so product-reviewer status compatibility bypasses context checks even though the source plan describes its INIT dependency as unresolved and the current INIT contract still requires it. Exact execution allows `Set testIntent on every checklist item.` for status compatibility with policyStatus=allowed-role-status. This contradicts the M0.4 active non-legacy prompt boundary and lets --write bless active legacy instructions in a live compatibility lane. Enforce every non-legacy/non-retired status, or define a narrow negative-reference exemption instead of a status-wide bypass.

doc-code-drift: The new uniform Commands contract says the column includes role-owned writes plus role-defining inspection/execution calls from each role-specific procedure, and the verifier now prints that all human-authored role-matrix semantics remain reviewer-audited. Two such calls are still omitted: lattice-evaluator-cli explicitly runs `cat .lattice-serve.json`, but its row lists only bridge curl calls and optional CLI spawn and its directFileAccess text omits that file read; lattice-review-story-init explicitly requires the Edit tool to write the answer field, but its row lists only Read/Grep, init_check_set, and cat/echo. Neither call is a universal Runtime Guide navigation read, prohibited command, or another role's artifact/input, so the Commands/all-fields audit claim is incomplete despite JSON/Markdown parity. Add these role-specific calls (and the evaluator file read) to ROLE_MATRIX_DEFAULTS and regenerate the baseline/matrix, or narrow the Commands contract and F-020 INFO wording so they do not claim coverage.
